name: Spirit Ridden (Mythic)
body:
You learned to become a true friend of the spirits.

Prerequisite(s): Spirit Ridden

Benefit(s): Your called spirit stays with you for 24 hours.

You gain the Psychic Sensitivity or Signature Skill feat (your choice) for the purpose of using skill unlocks with the granted skill, for all the time the séance’s effects last.
